name: Providing For A Family
overview: Scripture teaches that providing for a family involves faithful stewardship and the responsible meeting of needs, as seen in Exodus 21:10 where a husband must not diminish the provision for his wife. Trusting in God's provision is central, for those who seek the Lord will lack no good thing (Psalms 34:10), and God promises to supply all needs according to His riches in glory through Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19). Believers are also called to act justly and generously, withholding no good from those to whom it is due when it is within their power (Proverbs 3:27), while recognizing that God's wisdom and ways surpass human understanding (Isaiah 55:8).
